verbetes.glosa_atual: (n. h.) pr. n. m. Tobias, Tobias.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Tobijah, Tobias.
notas_originais: Kidd. 70 b בטי בר ט', a slave. Keth. 85 b שני ט' two by the name of T.—Pes. 113 b, a. e., v. זִיגָּד.—Lev. R. s. 1, beg.; Sot. 12 a (one of the names of Moses).
, v. טוֹבַנְיָא
Gitt. 26 b; Keth. 40 a; Kerith. 13 b ט' דחכימי happiest of all scholars.
, Bets. 13 a, read: טִבְלָא.
— Pl. טוֹבְלָנִים, constr. טוֹבְלָנֵי. Tosef. Yad. I, 20 Var., v. טָבל I.
Tosef. Shebi. VII, 14 Pes. 53 a; Erub. 28 b טובי'.
, v. טֶבֵע 2.
Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 17; a. fr. (O. טוֹפָנָ א).
Taan. 10 a ט' ולא יובשני better flooded land than rainless land.
= טִבְעוֹנִי.
Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 50. [Targ. Jud. V, 26 some ed., read טַבְתָא.]

Sifré Deut. 234 פרט ליגא; Yalk. Deut. 933 ליגא; Treat. Tsitsith (ed. Kirchheim p. 22) הטריגון (corr. acc.).— Pl. טוֹגִיּוֹת. Sifré l. c. quot. in Ar., s. v. טג: טגיות אינן וֹכ' (read: טוג') togae are exempt from tsitsith
, v. טֹהַר
, v. טוי
, v. טַפְזָא (a. next w.)

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= טַב זִיג, v. זוֹגָא) companhia alegre, piquenique de rapazes.; significa um piquenique (não um casamento). [Perles et. St. 11 refere-se a Pess. ṭ ûz ͗ i.
definicoes_originais: (= טַב זִיג, v. זוֹגָא) merry company, picnic of young men.
means a picnic (not a wedding). [Perles Et. St. p. 11 refers to Pers. ṭ ûz ͗ i.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 14 a בט' (Ms. M. בטווזא) ‘the son’s feast’ of which R. Judah speaks (Tosef. ib. I, 2
ṭ uśi, Arab. תוזיע̇.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טוּחַ II) pressionar o arco, tiro, distância de tiro.
definicoes_originais: (טוּחַ II) pressing the bow, shot, shooting distance.
notas_originais: — Pl. טְוָוחִים, טְיָחִ'. Gen. R. s. 53 (ref. to כמטחוי, Gen. XXI, 16) שני ט' בקשת מיל (‘Rashi’ a. l. טִיחוֹת) two shooting distances with the bow are a mile (מִיל); Yalk. Gen. 94.
, part. pass. of טָוָה.
, v. sub טוי'.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טוּס; cmp. ταώς, Pers. tavus, v. Lydd.
definicoes_originais: (טוּס; cmp. ταώς, Pers. tavus, v. Lydd.
notas_originais: Gr. Dict. s. v.) peacock. Gen. R. s. 7, end. Tosef. Kil. I, 8 תרנגול ט' וכ' Var. (ed. Zuck. טוות, corr. acc.) the cock, the peacock and the pheasant, although resembling each other, &c.; Y. ib. I, 27 a bot.; B. Kam. 55 a (Ms. H. טָאוָס); Y. ib. V, end, 5 a טַוֶּוסֶת(?).— Pl. טַוָּוסִים, טַוָּוסִין. Pesik. R. addit. s. 1 (ed. Fr. p. 193 b). Yalk. Esth. 104 b ט' של שן peacocks made of ivory.
Targ. II Esth. I, 2.—Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 d top (expl. Adrammelech and Anammelech, II Kings XVII, 3

Sabb. 130 a רישא דט' וכ' Ms. M. (Ms. O. טָאוָסָא, ed. incorr. טוותא) the head of a peacock cooked in milk.— Pl. טַוָּוסִין, טַוְוסִין, טַוְסִ'. Targ. Ez. XXVII, 15 (h. text הובנים). Targ. I Kings X, 22 (h. text תכיים).
, v. טְיָפָא
, v. טיְּרָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Ταῦρος) Taurus Amanus (v. אֲמָנָה II,; corresponde a Hor-Hahar.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Num. XXXIV, 7, sq. (O. הר טורא).—Targ. Y. ib. XX, 22; 25; Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 50 (!) (Y. II a. O. הור טורא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (radical טה, טו, cmp. טהר; cmp. árabe.
definicoes_originais: (stem טה, טו, cmp. טהר; cmp. Arab.
notas_originais: ṭ avi) [ clearness, emptiness,] (adv.) with an empty stomach, without meal, fasting. Dan. VI, 19.—Pes. 107 a, v. בִּית—Ber. 55 a כל חלום בלא ט' Ms. M. (ed. ולא) no dream is to be feared in which fasting plays no part; [Ar.: every dream has some reality, except that which one dreams while fasting].
, v. טַוָּוס, טַוָּוסָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); cobrir com substância coesa, rebocar.; ser colado, colar.; rebocar, polir.
definicoes_originais: to cover with a cohesive substance, to plaster.
to be pasted on, to stick.
to cast mud, trnsf. (with or without דברים) to speak rebelliously, to reproach (with נגד or כלפי).
notas_originais: Part. טָח. M. Kat. 7 a ואינו טָח בטיט but puts no clay on. Cant. R. to VIII, 6 טָחֵי גגות roof-plasterers. Neg. XIII, 1 וטח and plasters the spot over; a. fr.— Part. pass. טוּחַ coated, covered with viscid or glittering matter.—Midd. IV, 1 ט' בזהב coated with gold; (Num. R. s. 12 נִטּוֹחַ).—Nidd. 24 a בפניו טוּחוֹת (Rashi טָחוֹת) when the face of the embryo is covered over (no features distinguishable).

Y. Kil. VI, 30 c top והיא נִיטּוֹחָה and it (the fig) stuck (against the wall); Y. Sabb. XI, 13 a bot. והיה נ' (corr. acc.). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17 לִיטּוֹחַ some ed. (ed. Zuck. ליטול, corr. acc.), v. infra.

Ḥull. 25 a … עתיד (לַהֲטִיחוֹ) להָטִיחַ וכ' (Tosef. Kel. l. c. ליטוח, v. supra) which wants polishing, v. אֲטוּנָס. Bets. 9 a להָטִיחַ גגו וכ' he needs the ladder for plastering his roof. [Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 19, sq. [read:] אם יכול הטיח, v. טִיחַ.]

Taan. 25 a; Meg. 22 b, a. e. לעולם אל יָטִיחַ וכ' one must, in his prayer, never reproach the Lord. Ber. 31 b, sq.—Gen. R. s. 53 (ref. to כמטחוי, Gen. XXI, 16) כמֵטַחַת וכ' as if thrusting reproaches against the Lord; Tanḥ. Vayetse 5. Ex. R. s. 3. B. Bath. 134 a ה' עלי וכ' Ben U. insulted me.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , para engessar, manchar.; mesmo. Zeb. 95 mesmo.; (com מִלִּין) falar de forma rebelde.
notas_originais: Pes. 30 a, v. טִיחְיָא.
Zeb. 95 b אַטְחוּ (Ms. R. 2 דטחו), v. טִיחְיָא.
Targ. Y. Gen. XV, 6.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. טחי) pressionar, apertar.; pressionar, apertar, bater contra.; pressionar a corda do arco, atirar; (eufem.) para emitir sêmen viril.
definicoes_originais: to press the bow-string, to shoot; (euphem.) to emit semen virile.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 109 b טָחוֹ בכותל presses it against the wall (to make the milk flow out).— Part. pass. טוּחַ squeezed in. Num. R. s. 10 (ref. to Job XXXVIII, 36) אלו הכליות שהן טוּחוֹת וכ' that means the kidneys which are wedged into the body.

Ber. 34 b אלמלי ה' וכ' (Ms. M. הניח, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if Ben. Z. (myself) had squeezed his head between his (the son’s) knees (praying for his recovery). Gen. R. s. 20 התחיל מֵטִיחַ וכ' he knocked his head against the wall; Yalk. ib. 30 להָטִיחַ. Ohol. XVII, 2 ה' בסלע struck (with the plough) against a rock. B. Kam. 28 b ה' צלוחיתו וכ' he struck (with) his bottle against the stone; Y. ib. III, 3 c top, v. הֲטָחָה.—Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 כיון שהֵטִיחוּ פניהם וכ' when they had squeezed their faces from all sides (had in vain tried in all directions).
Yeb. 54 a. Snh. 46 a ה' באשתו Ms. M. (ed. את אשתו).
— Pl. טוֹחֲנִים. Tanḥ. Mishp. 19 כגון חמורים של ט' like the mask over the faces of the millers’ asses.
M. Kat. 16 a ט' אסר וכ' a blow binds (proclaiming excommunication), and a blow unbinds.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= טלטל'; טְלַל) ramos da videira, caramanchão.
definicoes_originais: (= טלטל'; טְלַל) branches of the vine, arbor.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 10; Targ. Y. II Deut. XXIV, 21 טוֹטְלָוַותְ'.
, v. טוֹטֶפְתָּא
, v. טֹטַפְרָ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: no plural; = טפטפ', v. [algo brilhante,] contas usadas como amuletos, enfeite usado na testa, frontal.
definicoes_originais: [ something glistening,] beads used as charms, ornament worn on the forehead, frontlet.
notas_originais: Sabb. VI, 1, expl. ib. 57 b, v. חוּמַרְתָּא a. אֲפוּזְיָינֵי; Y. ib. VI, 7 d דבר שהוא נותן במקום הט' (read נָתוּן) something which is put on by women in the place of the totafoth (by men, v. infra).— Pl. טוֹטָפוֹת. Tosef. ib. IV (V), 6.—Esp. pl. טוֹטָפוֹת phylacteries, (corresp. to אות, Deut. VI, 8, a. e.) slips of parchment containing inscriptions and put in the casings of the T’fillin (v. תְּפִלִּין). Mekh. Bo. s. 17 מה בראש ארבע ט' אף ביד ארבע ט' as the T’fillin on the head contain four inscriptions, so those on the hand. Snh. XI, 3 (88 b); a. e.

Targ. II Sam. I, 10 ט' דעל ידא bracelet (h. text אצעדה).— Pl. טוֹטְפָתָא, טוֹטְפָן phylacteries, v. preced. Targ. Esth. VIII, 15 (cmp. Men. 35 b). Targ. Ez. XXIV, 17; 23 (h. text פאר, cmp. M. Kat. 15 a; Keth. 6 b).
, v. טִיטְרַפְלִיּוֹת

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) [ ir e voltar, cmp. זוּל, אֲזַל,] girar.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ to go to and back, cmp. זוּל, אֲזַל,] to spin.
notas_originais: Keth. VII, 6 טוֹוָה בשוק she spins in the street. Ib. 72 b, v. וֶרֶד II.—Tosef. Toh. IV, 11; Zeb. 79 b פשתן שטְוָואֲתוֹ וכ' linen which a menstruant spun.— Part. pass. טָווּי. Kil. IX, 8 ט' או ארוג spun or woven, v. שַׁעַטְנֵז. Sabb. 79 a; a. e.—V. טֳוִי.
Denom. מַטְוִויאֲתָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido. wds.) [virar,] assar.; para ser assado.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced. wds.) [ to turn,] to roast.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XLIV, 16 (ed. Wil. טְוָה); a. fr.—Part. pass. טָוֵי, constr. טְוֵי. Targ. Ex. XII, 8, sq.—Gitt. 69 b נִיטַוְויֵיה וכ' let him roast it in a smithy; a. fr.
same. Bets. 4 a מהו לאַטְוִוינְהוּ וכ' is it permitted to roast them to-day &c.
Pes. 76 b דאִיטְּוָוא וכ' which was roasted together with meat. B. Kam. 19 b דמִטְּוֵוי (Ar. בטָוִוי) it means that it was roasted. Ber. 44 b משיתא מִטְּוָויָתָא than six (eggs) roasted.
Meg. 26 b; Snh. 48 a, v. אָרִיג. Tosef. B. Kam. X, 2 טאוי (read טְוָאי, Var. טְוָוי).
B. Kam. 19 a Ar. (v. טְוִי II).—Sabb. 109 a שריקא ט' a roast glaired, Rashi (differ. in Tosaf.) Y. Ter. X, 47 b top טַוְויָה.
Lev. R. s. 25 (expl. בטחות, Job XXXVIII, 36) בט' (Ar. בטיטויא; cmp. LXX Job. l. c.); v., however, בִּטְוַיָּא.
Sabb. 74 b. Ib. 79 a; a. fr.
, v. טַוְיָא
, v. טיוסין
, imperat. of נָטַל, נְטַל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Pi.; passear, ter lazer, divertir-se.; para fazer caminhada.
definicoes_originais: to walk about, to be at leisure, to enjoy one’s self.
notas_originais: טִיֵּיל

Snh. 102 a נְטַיֵּיל בג"ע we shall walk about in paradise. Succ. 28 b ומְטַיֵּיל בסוכה and enjoys himself &c. Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 18; Tosef. Bets. II, 10, v. טְרִיקְלִין. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 3; a. fr.
Ib. טִיַּילְתַּנִי עמך thou madest me walk by thy side.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , andar, dar passos largos.; caminhar, viajar.; como precedente. Pi.—Targ. Y. Gen. III, 8 (h. texto מתהלך).; para ir embora, mandar embora.
definicoes_originais: as preced. Pi.—Targ. Y. Gen. III, 8 (h. text מתהלך).
notas_originais: Targ. Jer. L, 11 (h. text צהל; cmp. Targ. ib. VIII, 16).
Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 61. Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 20. Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 8 טַיַּילְתָּא (ed. Wil. טְיַלְ'; h. text צעד); a. fr.

—Y. Ber. III, 6 a, a. fr. הוו מְטַיְּילִין וכ' were walking about &c. B. Bath. 91 b כד הוו מְטַיְּילָן וכ' when boys and girls used to play &c. Succ. 53 a הוה מט' קמיה וכ' (Ar. מטלל) was sporting before &c., v. טְלַל; a. fr.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXIV, 1; 3 (ed. pr. ישיל, corr. acc.).
Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 52 Ms. (ed. אַטֵּיל).

Targ. Jud. IX, 36; a. fr.—Yoma 74 b תוב בט' sit in the shade.—Gitt. 17 a או בטוּלָּךְ וכ' either let us live in thy shadow (protection) or in the shadow of the son of Esau (Rome). Snh. 18 b בט' תאינה in the shade of a fig-tree; Y. R. Hash. II, 58 b top בטֻל תינתא; Y. Snh. I, 18 c bot. בטיל הינתא (corr. acc.); a. fr.— Pl. טוּלַּיָּא, טוּלֵּי. Targ. Jer. VI, 4; a. e.—Targ. Is. IX, 1 בארע טולי מותא ed. Lag (oth. ed. טוּלֵימוֹתָא in one word, h. text צלמית).—Pes. 111 b חמשה ט' וכ' there are five shades (where demons dwell); a. e.—V. טְלָלָא.

definicoes_originais: (cmp. טְלָאי) rag tied around the finger.
notas_originais: Meïl. 18 a עומד לט' Ar. (ed. לנוולה; v. R. S. to Kel. XXVII, 4) fit for tying &c.
, v. טוּלָּא

(טְלַם) טוּלְמת [ panis aqueus ac mollis, P. Sm. 1477] cake, loaf. Targ. Job. XXXI, 17 ט' דלחמי Ms. (ed. only טולמי); a. e.—Targ. Esth. III, 2 ט' דלחם ed. Lag.; Yalk. ib. 105 b ט' דנהמא.—[Y. Snh. II, 20 c bot. מנהם טלמא, v. טַלְמָיָא.]— Pl. טוּלְמִין, טוּלְמֵי. Targ. I Kings XIV, 3; a. e.—Meg. 15 b בטולמי דנהמא Ms. M. 2 (ed. only בטַלְמֵי) for loaves of bread. [Ar. s. v. זיף quotes, in Hebr. diction, (play on Josh. XV, 24) כל המוזיף טולמיין וכ' ed. Koh. (oth. ed. טולמין, טולמון) he who lends bread to the poor, will be raised.]
, v. next w.

Gen. R. s. 41, beg.; s. 52 (ref. to Gen. XII, 17) [read:] על דו ט' למקרב למסנא וכ' because he dared to come near the shoe of that matron; Y. Keth. VII, end, 31 d על דטלמסן למגע בסמה (corr. acc.); Yalk. Gen. 69.
, Yalk. Josh. 31, read פּוֹלָר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: maçã silvestre (cmp. Syr. טלש, P. Sm. 1482).
notas_originais: — Pl. טוּלְשֵׁי. Ber. 40 b (expl. עוזרדין of Dem. I, 1).
B. Kam. 51 b טָם טפח if one filled up again one hand-breadth (of the depth of the pit).
Targ. II Kings III, 19, v. טְמַם.—B. Kam. 50 a עד דטָאִים ליה (Ms. M. אָטֵים Af., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) until he fills it up.
Erub. 79 a למִיטַּיְּימֵיה קאי the intention is that it be filled up (with the pebbles).

definicoes_originais: uncleanness, esp. levitical uncleanness, v. טַהֲרָה.
notas_originais: Pes. 19 a טוּמְאַת ידים uncleanness of hands by touch. Eduy. II, 1, v. אָב. M. Kat. 5 a ט' קוראה וכ' the uncleanness (the unclean spot being marked) calls unto him warning &c.; a. v. fr.— Pl. טוּמְאוֹת Kel. I, 1; a. v. fr.
Targ. Ez. XXII, 10.— Pl. טוּמְאָתָא. Targ. Is. XXX, 22.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τόμος); rolar, rolar, tomo.; documento, registro.; censo.
notas_originais: Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 31 בט' של וכ' with a roll of papers in his hand; Y. ib. VIII, beg. 6 b; Sifra Emor Par. 14, ch. XX טימסמירות, טימיסמ' (read: ט' של ניירות or שטרות); Yalk. Lev. 658; a. e.

Y. Hor. III, 48 a bot. ראש טי' at the head of the list; Lev. R. s. 5 בראש ט' Ar. (ed. only בראש). Gen. R. s. 25 beg. בתוך טִימוֹסָן וכ' in the record of the righteous; Yalk. ib. 42; Yalk. Chr. 1072 טִימוֹסִין pl.— Pl. טוֹמוֹסִין, טוֹמוֹסוֹת, טִי'. Pesik. Zakh. p. 27 a [read:] ונטל ט' וכ' (or טִימוֹסָן) he took the lists of the tribes &c.; Tanḥ. Ki Thetse 9. Y. Snh. X, 28 a top אף שמותיהם … טֹמְסוֹתֵיהֶם even their names disappeared from their books of records. Ex. R. s. 15 הוציא הנמוסין וכ' (corr. acc.; Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 דִּפְתְּרָא) he brought out the lists of the deities.
Lam. R. to II, 2 היה טימס … בעגלה their census had to be carried to Jerusalem on a wagon; [Y. Taan. IV, 69 a bot. קטמו' read הטומוס or קִינְסוֹס].

verbetes.glosa_atual: (redupl. de טָמַם) uma pessoa cujos órgãos genitais estão ocultos ou pouco desenvolvidos; aquele cujo sexo é desconhecido.
definicoes_originais: (redupl. of טָמַם) a person whose genitals are hidden, or undevelopped; one whose sex is unknown.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 126 b ט' שנקרע וכ' a tumtum who was operated upon and was found to be a male. Bicc. IV, 5 (Talm. ed.); a. e.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. I; Yalk. Prov. 953 ט' הוא העולם, v. אַבְטוֹמְטוֹס.]— Pl. טוּמְטוּמִין. Yeb. 64 a bot. (not טומטמין).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טוּם; cmp. סָתַם, סָתַר) lugar secreto e escondido.
definicoes_originais: (טוּם; cmp. סָתַם, סָתַר) secret, hidden place.

notas_originais: Denom. טַוָּוס.

—Y. Taan. IV, 69 b לא נראה עיף טָס וכ' no bird has been seen flying in all Palestine; Lam. R. introd. end.—Deut. R. s. 6 קושט … וטס כעוף goes straight like an arrow, and swift like a bird. Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 10 גזין חשין וטָסִין they pass, hasten and fly; a. fr.
same. Koh. R. to IX, 7 ט' וחזר וט' he flew to and back.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; [brilhar,] vir à superfície, flutuar, borbulhar.; (denominação de טיף) pingar; ser inundado.; para direcionar o overflow, para atribuir canais.
definicoes_originais: [ to shine,] to come to the surface, float, bubble up.
(denom. of טיף) to drip; to be inundated.
to direct the overflow, to assign channels.
to cause to glisten, to turn in all directions.
to cause to float, v. infra.
to be glittering, to be turned in all directions.
notas_originais: Part. טָאֵיף, טָיֵיף. Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 1. Targ. Y. Gen. XXVIII, 10; a. e.—Koh. R. to V, 8 (mixed diction) וטָפַת בארה של וכ' Miriam’s well came up.—Ab. II, 6; Succ. 53 a, v. infra.—Y. Shebi. IX, 38 d; Pesik. B’shall. p. 89 b הוה טָיֵיף the corpse came up to the surface. Gen. R. s. 81 (in Hebr. dict.) וטָפַת רוחי וכ' and my mind in me was swimming (I became proud, v. טָפַח); a. fr.

Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 12; a. e.—Keth. 111 b חלבא טייף וכ' milk was dripping &c. Y. Taan. III, end, 67 a הוה עלמא ט' the world would have been flooded. Gen. R. s. 32; Yalk. ib. 57 דלא טף וכ' it (the mount Gerizim) was not flooded by the waters of the flood; a. e.—[Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 23 תטופון, v. טְנַף a. נְטַף.]
Targ. Job XXXVIII, 24, v. טְיָפָא.—Gitt. 69 b top ונִיטַּיְיפֵיה וכ' and let it (the milk) run over &c.
Keth. 60 b מְטַיְּפֵי עינא Ar. (ed. מציצי, v. infra) with restless eyes.
Targ. Deut. XI, 4.—[Keth. l. c. מְטִיפֵי עינא Ar. s. v. טף I ‘with dripping eyes’, v. supra.]

Strack (oth. eds. אַטְפוּךְ; Strack reads מְטַיְפָיךְ Pa.; oth. pointed eds. מְטיְּפָיִךְ h. form) because thou (the person whose skull was seen to float) hast caused (a corpse) to float, they made thee float, and those who made thee float, shall also float.
B. Kam. 92 b; Meg. 14 b ועיניה מִטַּיְּיפֵי and its eyes look all around (for food).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. טָפַס; cmp. דָּפוּס, טָפוּס) quadro; trnsf. (influenciado pelo grego τύπος) fórmula (a preencher conforme a ocasião).
definicoes_originais: (v. טָפַס; cmp. דָּפוּס, טָפוּס) frame; trnsf. (influenced by Greek τύπος) formula (to be filled out according to occasion).
notas_originais: Y. Ber. I, 3 d ט' ברכות וכ' such is the formula of the benedictions; Lev. R. s. 34, end; Y. Sabb. XV, end, 15 b טופוס.—Esp. the formula or blank of documents, opp. תורף containing names, dates &c. Y. Gitt. III, beg. 44 c כתב תרפו בט' (also בתוֹפֵס) if the writer filled out a blank. B. Mets. 7 b; a. fr.— Pl. טוֹפְסִין, constr. טוֹפְסֵי. Y. Gitt. II, beg. 44 a פוסל בט' declares illegal deeds of divorce written into ready-made blanks. Gitt. III, 2 הכותב ט' גיטין וכ' he who writes formulas of letters of divorce must leave blanks for the name &c.; a. fr.
